main_task: Help farmers who registered but never opened the Rytu Khata app to add it to their home screen, step by step.
sources: Open the link we sent on WhatsApp, tap Add to home screen, then open the app once.

answer.opening_line: Hello {{lead_name}}, I am calling from Rytu Khata about the app you registered for. Can you talk now?

stages.name: Open the link
stages.instruction: Ask them to open the link they got.
stages.sounds_like: Please open the link we sent you.

ways_out.when: They are busy now or say they will do it later
They are not interested or it is the wrong person

stages.name: Finalise the call
stages.instruction: Check the app opened and thank them.
stages.sounds_like: Thank you, the app is ready now.
